tools.name: list_fren_countries
tools.description: Lists the countries where FREN offers camera alerts, offline maps or offline navigation, with the availability of each. Returns country codes and names only.

tools.name: get_fren_coverage
tools.description: Reports whether camera alerts, offline maps and offline navigation are available in one country. Returns availability only and does not return any individual camera data.

tools.name: find_place
tools.description: Finds up to 5 places matching a name in one country and returns their names and coordinates. Results come from OpenStreetMap data.

tools.name: plan_route
tools.description: Plans a driving route between two points in one country and returns the distance, the travel time and the main steps. It does not return a map, and drivers must follow road signs.
